summary.headline: Omens in the Air Signs
summary.text: Astrological omens for Saturnian conditions in Gemini, Libra, and Aquarius, including social unrest, disease, market stagnation, weather, warfare, and regional events in India, Babylon, Fars, and Rome. The conjunction of Mercury and Saturn in the watery triplicity signifies rain, hail, freezing, damage to plants, shipwrecks, caravan arrivals, and agricultural prosperity.
